python3 -c "
import re
NUM_UNIT_PATTERN = (
    r'%|milliseconds?|msecs?|seconds?|secs?|minutes?|mins?|hours?|days?|weeks?|months?|years?|'
    r'ms|s|m|h|d|GB|MB|KB|TB|GiB|MiB|KiB|px|个|次|秒|分钟|小时|天|倍|条|行|列'
)
NUM_RE = re.compile(rf'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*({NUM_UNIT_PATTERN})?(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', re.I)
for s in ['仅超过 75,000 条的请求需要拆批；恰好 75,000 条可以直接提交。',
          '仅超过 **75,000** 条的请求需要拆批；恰好 **75,000** 条可以直接提交。',
          '仅超过 **75,000 条**的请求需要拆批；恰好 **75,000 条**可以直接提交。',
          '默认间隔为 **8 秒**；日志中的单位为毫秒。']:
    print(repr(s))
    print('   ', [(m.group(0), m.group(1), m.group(2)) for m in NUM_RE.finditer(s)])
"

for p in ['input.md', '.work/cand_c.md', '.work/cand_d.md']:
